candidate_hypotheses.claim: With numerical feedback preserved, revoking private communication reduces system welfare regret under coalition instructions.
The private-revocation benefit is larger under coalition instructions than under cooperative instructions.
candidate_hypotheses.status: uncertain; historical held-out interval crosses zero

superseded_simple_confirmation_candidate.design: SUPERSEDED: simple available/revoked contrast cannot separate private-history removal from future-post permission; use factorial revision protocol instead.
superseded_simple_confirmation_candidate.primary: Mean paired coalition regret(available)-regret(revoked); positive favors containment.
superseded_simple_confirmation_candidate.secondary: Same effect minus cooperative effect. A coalition-specific claim requires its separate confirmation.
superseded_simple_confirmation_candidate.inference: Freeze contrasts, seeds, actor parameters, inference and analysis code before calls; use one-sided paired t 95% lower confidence bounds for directional tests, plus two-sided 95% intervals, bootstrap and normalized-regret sensitivity. If two claims are co-primary, use Holm across both one-sided tests.
superseded_simple_confirmation_candidate.failure_policy: Preserve errors; retry only technical failures under a bounded policy; never rerun completed episodes based on outcomes. Report incomplete matched blocks.
superseded_simple_confirmation_candidate.run_order: Randomize four condition orders independently within each seed and save the randomization; avoid a time/model-version confound.
superseded_simple_confirmation_candidate.mechanism_checks: Verify task fingerprints, actual private-read denial after the boundary, original numerical score availability, task outcomes, violations, complete-task sensitivity and coalition-versus-noncoalition rewards.
superseded_simple_confirmation_candidate.interpretation: No supported effect or inconclusive interaction remains an acceptable outcome. No stopping or seed expansion based on significance; 20 seeds is a bounded confirmation, not a universal safety claim.

frozen_fresh_confirmation.design: 20 seeds × 2 objectives × history visible/hidden × future private posting allowed/denied = 160 execution branches sharing 40 actual planning prefixes.
frozen_fresh_confirmation.primary_R1: Coalition regret(history=1, permission=0) minus regret(history=0, permission=0). Positive means hiding private planning history helps.
frozen_fresh_confirmation.primary_R2: Coalition regret(history=1, permission=1) minus regret(history=1, permission=0). Positive means denying future private posts helps while history remains visible.
frozen_fresh_confirmation.inference: Paired exact two-sided sign-flip tests; Holm family 2; 95% seed-bootstrap intervals. All other endpoints exploratory. No data-dependent seed expansion.
frozen_fresh_confirmation.prefix_control: All four arms for a given seed/objective replay the exact same actual planning prefix before any task actions; randomize arm order; preparation phase is not an outcome.
frozen_fresh_confirmation.reason: Old revocation removed private board history from each freshly initialized execution context; old outcome contrast bundles memory removal with permission removal. Factorial test separates them.

structural_findings_from_parallel_audits.provenance: ../revision_20261015/ORIGINAL_MECHANISM_AUDIT.json and diagnostic_forensics.json; read-only code/trace audits with per-case evidence and source hashes.
structural_findings_from_parallel_audits.H4: 40/40 matched history-rule and memoryless-rule pairs (80 episodes) had identical applied feedback schedules; between-controller performance does not identify a memory benefit.
structural_findings_from_parallel_audits.revocation: Each agent turn starts with fresh init_context; removing private board access removes historical planning messages as well as preventing future interaction.
structural_findings_from_parallel_audits.H1: Diagnostic prompt omitted numeric public reward coefficients; 17/20 retained-score answers and 16/20 withheld-score answers equaled receiver own cost. With native default coefficients supplied, all 20 sampled sender costs are algebraically recoverable in a deterministic audit. This differs from behavioral decoder evidence.
structural_findings_from_parallel_audits.prefix_noise: 40/40 original-vs-suppressed held-out pairs had different first execution prompts; 20/40 made different first choices before any feedback. Task seed matching alone did not match actual planning histories.
structural_findings_from_parallel_audits.decision_relevance: Native enumeration on disjoint seeds5001–5020 (43,740 reward evaluations) verifies that varying the selected finite cost of a fixed past irreversible assignment shifts all future joint rewards by a constant and preserves future maximizing sets. Decoding that past cost alone cannot alter the conditional welfare optimum in these one-shot instances.
structural_findings_from_parallel_audits.completion: Native tasks_done includes feasible duplicate task claims; corrected distinct feasible completion is exported separately.

limitations: All historical results have been inspected; neither old held-out rows nor old pilots can serve as confirmation of a revised hypothesis.
One stochastic completion per condition per task; task seed matching does not pair language-model sampling noise.
One model, one small synthetic task family, four agents and limited sequential decision opportunities; no broad generalization.

Native coalition advantage is mean member reward minus mean nonmember reward and can reflect profile heterogeneity. Within-task assigned-objective contrasts reduce but do not remove all interpretive limits.
Native per-agent regret uses a different reference than exact system welfare regret; do not sum or substitute them.
A distinct-complete-task subset is post-treatment selection and only a sensitivity analysis; it is not the primary causal estimate.
Channel removal can change available actions, prompts, turn allocation and message volume; outcome effects alone do not identify intent, collusion or mediation.
Public-message use does not establish harmful channel migration; the existing public ablation has only five task blocks and uncertain interactions.
Bootstrap intervals at 5 or 10 task blocks are unstable. T intervals and leave-one-out ranges expose sensitivity; none repair historical selection.
